Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

## OMRON connect

The next generation OMRON connect US/CAN/EMEA app is here and it syncs with every one of our
connected blood pressure monitors and select body composition monitors! This app release features
expanded insights and new look and feel for monitoring your heart health. By wirelessly connecting
via **Bluetooth™**, you can easily upload, store and even share your heart history data with family
or physicians. And it even keeps track of your weight—so you can achieve your broader health goals.

## Imagine a healthier world

We believe the next generation won’t be defined by age, but by a world without heart attacks or
strokes. This is a world-changing mind-set we call Going for Zero™. We do our part through
technology supporting personal fitness, heart health, healthy lungs and freedom from pain. You bring
this commitment to life by understanding and sharing heart health with every step.

We’ve completely redesigned our payments solution to help you get paid—faster.

[Get started][32]

Questions? Speak to a human.

Questions? Speak to a human.

[Call 1-888-323-4289][33]

## Smart for businesses, smart for partners

With new features like easy onboarding and built-in fraud prevention, we’ve reimagined Authorize.net
to help you get paid fast. See what’s new for businesses and partners.

[For businesses][34]

[For partners][35]

## See how we’ve reimagined Authorize.net

### New features, built for speed

Get paid faster with customizable dashboards, smart AI support, and built-in fraud prevention—all
powered by Visa’s payments ecosystem.

### Take, request, and find payments

Get set up fast with a seamless, intuitive payment experience.

### Not sure about something? Ask Anet

Get the answers you need, fast, with our new AI support tool, Ask Anet.

### Workspaces that stay connected

Stay connected across tools, teams, and transactions—backed by Visa.

### Tools to stop fraud fast

Protect every payment with built-in, real-time fraud detection.

[Demo for businesses][36]

[Demo for partners][37]

## Make payments a growth engine for your business

#### Online payments

Offer flexible online payments with credit cards, debit cards, eChecks, and major digital wallets
like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal for secure, convenient checkout.

[ [Learn more about online payments] ][38]

#### Smartphone payments

Accept secure mobile payments with smartphones, supporting QR codes, digital wallets, and fast
tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

[ [Learn more about mobile payments] ][39]

#### In person with a card reader

Use Virtual Point of Sale to connect a card reader to your computer, sign in, and accept reliable
in‑person payments quickly and securely.

[ [Learn more about Virtual Point of Sale] ][40]

#### Over the phone

Process phone orders securely by entering customer details in the Virtual Terminal, allowing quick
manual payments through any web browser.

#### eCheck

Enable simple eCheck payments for recurring billing, invoices, and contactless transactions,
offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

#### Simple Checkout

Add Buy Now or Donate buttons to your site for fast checkout, ideal for nonprofits and merchants
selling single items or low‑volume products.

[ [Learn more about Simple Checkout] ][41]

## Accept the payment types your customers prefer

[American Express]

[Google Pay]
[JCB]
[Discover]
[Mastercard]
[PayPal]
[UnionPay]
[Visa]

[Start accepting payments][42]

Get free support from real people, 24/7.

[Support Center][43]

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products

biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial

cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# The Future of Respiratory Monitoring

The Future of Respiratory Monitoring The Future of Respiratory Monitoring The Future of Respiratory
Monitoring The Future of Respiratory Monitoring

**Operating Room Quality Respiratory Data at the Patient Bedside**

#### Every Breath Counts®

Linshom Medical is the **first **to deliver a wearable, FDA-cleared, operating room quality
respiratory profile to the patient’s bedside. This provides early warning of respiratory problems
and may help avoid costly rapid response activations, rescue events (codes), ICU transfers and
deaths. 

[Learn More][34]

## Mission

 

### **We intend to eliminate the morbidity‭, ‬mortality‭, ‬and expense due to unrecognized respiratory
### decline in healthcare.‬**

 

## Recent News & Publications

#### About Us

[Meet the Team][35]

#### Why is respiratory monitoring important?

 Adequate ventilation is an important concern for patients and physicians in many situations and
environments. Patients often exhibit depressed respiration following surgery, as a result of
post-surgical pain, sedation secondary to analgesic medications, ineffective airway clearance, or
impaired gas exchange. The Linshom Medical Continuous Predictive Respiratory Monitor (CPRM) is
capable of non-invasively and portably measuring Respiratory Rate (RR), Seconds Since Last Breath
(SSLB), and trend of Relative Tidal Volume in patients with an oxygen mask. 

[Respiratory monitoring, importance of respiratory monitoring, medical monitor in hospital, apnea]

Mannai Healthcare division is a technology leader with advanced standards of technological solutions
and proven services and application competence. In more than two decades since its inception, the
division continues to make immense contributions to Qatar’s growing and ambitious healthcare and
scientific research sectors.

The division is actively following the pulse of Healthcare innovation to bring latest technological
advances to the state of Qatar and thereby continually growing its business portfolio.

Being one of Qatar’s most reputed and well established players in this field the division is in an
outstanding position to boost its pipeline, revenue and contribution to the Healthcare community.

The team of Professionally qualified, certified and experienced personals strive endlessly to
achieve delight across all customer and vendor interfaces.

##### Healthcare Engineering

Being one of Qatar’s most reputed and well established players in this field the division is in an
outstanding position to boost its pipeline, revenue and contribution to the Healthcare community.The
team of Professionally qualified, certified and experienced personals strive endlessly to achieve

[Explore Healthcare Engineering][4]
[Healthcare Devices & Technology]

##### Healthcare Devices & Technology

The Healthcare Devices and Technology vertical offers healthcare equipment, Medical Devices and
healthcare IT solutions to cover entire spectrum of technological solutions required within the
healthcare services environment. We bring solutions that truly transform care delivery and builds
solutions that are smart, efficient and reliable with our technologies we aim to deliver solutions
that optimize clinical, financial and administrative work flows.

[Explore Healthcare Devices][5]
[Healthcare Software]

##### Healthcare Software

A one stop shop for all requirements catering to the needs of research, clinical, testing and
industrial laboratories in the country. From chemicals and reagents to high end imaging solutions,
testing equipment, laboratory information systems and laboratory infrastructure, we strive to
provide the latest technologies and innovations which aid and facilitate higher accuracy,
credibility and traceability in their work environment.

[Healthcare Software][6]

## SERVICE & CUSTOMER CARE

Customer care and support has been at the forefront in ensuring customer delight across our vast

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. # Simplify the most usable patient data from all devices with
# Rhythm360**^{®}**

[Request a Demo][14]

## Empowering next-gen providers to thrive with easily accessible Actionable Data.

[Request a Demo][15]

## We don't just help
## monitor patient health.
## We help nurture it.

[Request a Demo][16]

## Elevate your outreach efforts with our clinically trained
## Patient Care Team.

[Request a Demo][17]

## Transforming data into patient care.

The only cardiac data management company with a full-suite patient-care ecosystem that transforms
data from any device into life-saving insights and enhances patient outreach with a clinically
trained patient-engagement team.

[Learn More][18]
[Rhythm 360 Logo]

## **We simplify complex healthcare data to nurture patient health and empower care teams.**

Let us partner with you to manage

### Hypertension

Monitor longitudinal journey of hypertensive patients

### Heart Failure

Manage patient journey with automated, AI driven care pathways for remote monitoring using connected
external devices and/or implanted devices

### **Rhythm Management (CIEDs & Loops)**

Comprehensive cardiac device ecosystem provides effective data capture for standardized reports

### **Ambulatory Cardiac Monitors**

MCOTs, wearable EKGs, Cardiac patch monitoring, and more.

[Get Started][19]

## Revolutionize cardiac care with RhythmScience

### Better data. Simple workflows.

**Rhythm360®** is an integrated platform that creates a unified workspace to review, interpret, and
utilize data from patients and devices for hypertension management, heart failure management, and
rhythm management [CIEDs, MCOTs, EKGs, etc]. Receive actionable data from implantable or external
cardiac devices for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and rhythm disorders.

Access critical cardiology data with simple workflows.

[Learn more][20]
[Platform Screenshot]

### Remote cardiology made simple.

Technical services teams can supplement existing clinical care teams to provide expert patient
engagement services. Trained team members are available to help with alert management, patient
compliance, and health coaching.

Always on even when you're off.

[Learn more][21]

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot

  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.

## About Shanghai Ryu Medical Co., Ltd.

Shanghai Ryu Medical Co., Ltd. is one of the professional suppliers for Medical Instrument products
in China. Our dedicated team carries more than 10 years of hands-on experience in the medical field,
making us a reliable and knowledgeable partner for healthcare procurement worldwide.

We are a factory located in Jiangsu Province, strategically positioned near Shanghai Port — ensuring
fast, efficient, and cost-effective global logistics. Our core manufacturing capabilities cover
syringes, infusion sets, gloves, and face masks, all produced under rigorous quality control
standards.

In order to fulfill the increasing needs of our trusted and loyal customers, apart from our own
factory, we have established partnerships with more than 5 strategic partners who produce urine
bags, surgical gowns, medical tubes, wound dressings, syringes, diagnostics, and lab products —
giving you a comprehensive one-stop sourcing solution.

## Our Core Medical Products

We manufacture and supply a comprehensive range of high-quality disposable medical products, all
meeting international CE & ISO standards for safety and reliability.

💉

### Syringes

Precision-manufactured disposable syringes in multiple sizes, designed for safe and accurate
medication delivery in clinical and hospital settings.

🩺

### Infusion Sets

High-quality IV infusion sets engineered for smooth fluid delivery, compatible with standard IV bags
and bottles across healthcare environments.

🧤

### Medical Gloves

Latex, nitrile, and vinyl examination gloves offering excellent protection, tactile sensitivity, and
comfort for medical professionals.

😷

### Face Masks

Surgical and protective face masks with multi-layer filtration, providing reliable barrier
protection against airborne particles and contaminants.

your complete medical supply needs — all under our quality supervision.

trust — which is why we have built a rigorous, multi-layered quality control framework.

🏗️

We have established a strong, dedicated Quality Control team stationed directly on different
production lines. This real-time oversight ensures every product meets our strict internal standards
before it ever reaches our customers.

🔍

### Multi-Stage Inspection Process

Every product batch undergoes incoming material inspection, in-process quality checks, and final

We maintain complete production records and batch traceability for all products. Our documentation

# empowering Qare. anywhere. always.


advancing healthcare through connected care — providing real-time insights, supporting caregivers in
their decisions, and improving patient outcomes.



[ contact us ][23]

## smarter patient monitoring. simplified.

smartQare simplifies patient monitoring by replacing spot-checks, multiple devices, and complex
setups with one continuous, real-time solution. It supports more efficient workflows, reduces
complexity, and helps caregivers respond at the right moment with clear, reliable insights.
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][24]
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][25]
* [ [home monitoring] ][26]
* [ [in-hospital monitoring] ][27]
  
  ### [ in-hospital monitoring ][28]
  
  Spot checks on general wards can leave critical gaps in patient tracking and increase nurse
  workloads. smartQare’s continuous monitoring solutions provide real-time insights, improving
  patient safety and giving nurses time back to focus on direct care.
* [ [hospital-to-home monitoring] ][29]
  
  ### [ hospital-to-home monitoring ][30]
  
  Postoperative recovery requires close monitoring to detect complications early. smartQare makes it
  easy to track patients remotely as they transition from hospital to home, ensuring safety,
  supporting recovery, early discharge, reduction of average hospital stays, and even readmissions.
* [ [home monitoring] ][31]
  
  ### [ home monitoring ][32]
  
  smartQare’s solutions provide continuous care for individuals at home, whether recovering from
  illness, managing chronic conditions, or maintaining general health. viQtor monitors vital signs,
  activity, and falls, providing comfort and safety, while giving caregivers valuable insights for
  better care.

news flash

## viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives

smartQare technology will enable continuous remote patient monitoring across the Region Stockholm
for the hospital@home program led by Karolinska University Hospital.

Up to 15,000 patients will benefit annually from connected, hospital-level care at home through
real-time wearable monitoring.


[Discover the Karolinska initiative][33]

[viQtor powers one of Europe’s largest hospital@home initiatives]

Proud that smartQare is supporting the **Discovery Care at Home programme** in South Africa together
with [Cuviva AB][34] and [AIRO Health Care][35].


Discovery Health is South Africa’s largest medical scheme administrator and managed care provider,
accounting for 38.3% of the total membership of South African medical schemes, with a membership
base of approximately 2.7 million.




[Read about Discovery's Care at Home Programme][36]




[Link to Discovery's press release][37]

## [the growing challenges in healthcare][39]

Healthcare systems are under growing pressure from an aging population, workforce shortages, and
rising costs. Care teams are supporting more patients with increasingly complex needs, often with
limited time and resources, leading to higher workloads and strain.

At the same time, the need to make timely, well-informed decisions based on patient data is
increasing. This adds complexity to daily care delivery and can affect both care quality and
operational efficiency. In this environment, there is a clear need for smarter, more supportive
approaches that enable consistent, confident, and timely care.

## PRESSURE – Advancing Remote Cardiovascular Care Beyond the Hospital

PRESSURE (Personal HypErtenSion and Cardiovascular CaRE) is a collaborative innovation project
focused on advancing remote patient monitoring for cardiovascular care. This joint initiative brings
together smartQare,  FreeSenseSolutions, TU/e (EAISI), Catharina Hospital, and Eurocept Homecare,
with support from OPZuid, the European Union, and the Province of North Brabant.

Proud that smartQare is supporting the **Discovery Care at Home programme** in South Africa together
with [Cuviva AB][34] and [AIRO Health Care][35].


Discovery Health is South Africa’s largest medical scheme administrator and managed care provider,
accounting for 38.3% of the total membership of South African medical schemes, with a membership
base of approximately 2.7 million.

## Strategic Partnership Announcement

In response to growing pressure on healthcare systems worldwide, **Cuviva** and **smartQare** today
announced a strategic partnership aimed at transforming how patients are monitored and cared for at
home, particularly in the critical period following hospital discharge.



[Read about the partnership][38]

[Strategic Partnership Announcement]
healthcare challenges

## [the growing challenges in healthcare][39]

Healthcare systems are under growing pressure from an aging population, workforce shortages, and
rising costs. Care teams are supporting more patients with increasingly complex needs, often with
limited time and resources, leading to higher workloads and strain.

At the same time, the need to make timely, well-informed decisions based on patient data is
increasing. This adds complexity to daily care delivery and can affect both care quality and
operational efficiency. In this environment, there is a clear need for smarter, more supportive
approaches that enable consistent, confident, and timely care.

## PRESSURE – Advancing Remote Cardiovascular Care Beyond the Hospital

PRESSURE (Personal HypErtenSion and Cardiovascular CaRE) is a collaborative innovation project
focused on advancing remote patient monitoring for cardiovascular care. This joint initiative brings
together smartQare,  FreeSenseSolutions, TU/e (EAISI), Catharina Hospital, and Eurocept Homecare,
with support from OPZuid, the European Union, and the Province of North Brabant.
